status_meaning.accepted: In scope and has an exact fraction oracle from the source.
status_meaning.ambiguous: Facts or arithmetic are incomplete or inconsistent.
status_meaning.source_error: The source itself exposes a legal or factual error.
status_meaning.out_of_scope: Depends on wills, compulsory heirs, refusal, debt, adoption, or excluded law.
status_meaning.duplicate_source: Reproduced facts; not counted as an independent oracle.

cases.facts: A dies intestate with spouse B and children C,D. D dies before A and leaves I,Q. Estate is 1.
cases.source_result: B,C receive one unit each; I,Q split D's unit.
assumptions: Normalize the estate to 1 and test only the published intestate allocation.

cases.facts: A dies intestate with estate 1. Spouse B survives. Daughter C died before A and left X,Y. A's parents are alive but second rank.
cases.source_result: B receives one unit; X,Y split C's unit.
assumptions: Normalize the estate to 1 and retain only first-rank heirs used by the source.

cases.facts: A dies intestate with estate 1. Spouse B and children C,D,E survive.
cases.source_result: Four first-rank heirs receive equal shares.
assumptions: Normalize the estate to 1; all named first-rank heirs survive A.

cases.facts: A wills estate 1 to H while spouse B and minor child C are omitted.
cases.source_result: The source applies compulsory-heir rules.
assumptions: No oracle is extracted because wills and compulsory heirs are outside this engine.

cases.facts: C dies before A. A makes a valid will to C's child X; spouse B survives.
cases.source_result: Will and compulsory-heir rules are applied.
assumptions: No oracle is extracted because the result depends on a will and compulsory-heir rules.

cases.facts: C dies before A; D dies after A before receiving. D has spouse N and child K.
cases.source_result: The page switches between A's succession and D's later succession without a complete normalized trace.
assumptions: Do not infer omitted estate transitions or intermediate fractions.

cases.facts: A and C die at the same time; A's will gives half to C and half to K. C has X,Y.
cases.source_result: Will, same-time death, compulsory-heir, and representation rules are mixed.
assumptions: No oracle is extracted because a will and compulsory-heir rules control the result.

cases.facts: A and B own two houses. A wills one to B; A has five children and the eldest predeceased A leaving two children.
cases.source_result: The undisposed remainder is divided with will and representation rules.
assumptions: No oracle is extracted because testamentary allocation is outside this engine.

cases.facts: A has children from a prior marriage and lives with B's children. H dies before A; A dies; later X dies. Several estates exist.
cases.source_result: The source gives a multi-estate result but step-parent eligibility and arithmetic need review.
assumptions: Do not infer step-parent eligibility or repair the published arithmetic.

cases.facts: A dies with spouse and children; one child is disqualified, a will gives half to T, and a refusal variant is asked.
cases.source_result: Disqualification, compulsory-heir, will, and refusal rules are applied.
assumptions: No oracle is extracted because disqualification, refusal, and a will are outside scope.

cases.facts: A has two historical marriages, dies at the same time as child C, and leaves a will to C, B, and T.
cases.source_result: Historical-law assumptions and the same-time branch are not sufficiently reliable for an oracle.
assumptions: Treat the published result as non-authoritative; do not repair it into an oracle.

cases.facts: The same A/B/T/C same-time exercise as onthis-07 is repeated with minor name changes.
cases.source_result: Duplicate; not independent.
assumptions: Retain only for provenance and exclude it from independent coverage counts.

cases.facts: A wills inherited savings to adult H and omits minor K; the marital house is outside the will.
cases.source_result: Compulsory-heir rules are applied to a mixed will/statutory estate.
assumptions: No oracle is extracted because will and compulsory-heir rules control the result.

cases.facts: A dies with an invalid will. Separate assets 200, marital assets 100, funeral cost 40; spouse B and children M,N,C survive.
cases.source_result: Net estate 210 is divided equally among B,M,N,C.
assumptions: Use the source's net estate and test only the resulting equal statutory fractions.

cases.facts: A dies intestate leaving spouse B, son C, and daughter D. No amount is needed to test the equal-share rule.
cases.source_result: B,C,D inherit equally.
assumptions: Normalize the estate to 1; all named first-rank heirs survive A.

cases.facts: After B dies, creditor X seeks payment from funeral donations and the family house.
cases.source_result: The exercise applies debt and funeral-payment priority, not allocation.
assumptions: No oracle is extracted because debt and payment-priority rules are outside scope.

cases.facts: H dies intestate. H and spouse own common assets 2. Spouse and three adult children survive; H's parents are stated dead.
cases.source_result: H's one-half estate is split equally by spouse and three children.
assumptions: Normalize H's estate to 1 after separating the spouse's existing ownership.

cases.facts: A dies intestate. A and spouse B own common assets 5. Adult children C,D survive; the source treats parents as irrelevant.
cases.source_result: A's one-half estate is split equally by B,C,D.
assumptions: Normalize A's estate to 1 after separating B's existing ownership.

cases.facts: M dies intestate with children C,D,H. D predeceases M and leaves E,F.
cases.source_result: C,H each receive one third; E,F split D's one-third branch.
assumptions: Normalize M's estate to 1 and use only the descendants named in the source.

cases.facts: A source case gives predeceased daughter Anh's husband Tan and children representation rights.
cases.source_result: The source explicitly criticizes giving the husband representation rights; only descendants are eligible under its stated rule.
assumptions: Use the record only to document the rejected spouse-as-representative interpretation.

cases.facts: A and spouse B have children C,D,E; C has spouse and two children. A has a will and C dies at the same time as A.
cases.source_result: The published computation mixes will allocation and statutory representation.
assumptions: Do not extract an oracle without separable will and statutory calculations.

cases.facts: A multi-death exercise includes a parent, several children, a child dying before taking an inheritance, and multiple estates.
cases.source_result: The search result exposes a numeric solution but not enough intermediate facts for verification.
assumptions: Do not reconstruct missing facts or intermediate estate fractions.

cases.facts: An old-law exam case involves a deceased child and a grandchild representing that child.
cases.source_result: The material is based on BLDS 2005 and is historical, not a current BLDS 2015 oracle.
assumptions: Retain for provenance only; do not use historical-law output as a current oracle.
